title: UNDERSTANDING LANGUAGE PRIOR OF LVLMS BY CONTRASTING CHAIN-OF-EMBEDDING

bias_targets.methodology: Contrasting the layer-wise chain-of-embedding (hidden representations) between multimodal (vision-text) inputs and text-only (vision-removed) inputs to calculate Total Visual Integration (TVI), which quantifies the model's over-reliance on memorized textual patterns compared to actual visual evidence.
